title: A fixed pseudo-coherent cohomology sheaf is quasi-coherent
statement: Let Y be a scheme and E a pseudo-coherent object of D(O_Y). For every integer n, the n-th cohomology sheaf of E is quasi-coherent.

proof.text: Unpack IsPseudoCoherent to choose, for every point y, an open U(y) containing y and a finite-free complex P(y) representing E restricted to U(y). These opens cover Y. Only the finite-free terms and the representing isomorphism are needed; the upper bound is not used for this conclusion.

For each chosen open U, apply Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U to P. The equivalence preserves free sheaves (mapFreeIso with overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso), so every term on U.toScheme is quasi-coherent. For its short complex in degree n, isQuasicoherent_kernel makes the kernel of the outgoing differential quasi-coherent. isQuasicoherent_cokernel then makes the cokernel of the preceding term into that kernel quasi-coherent. ShortComplex.homologyIsoCokernelLift identifies this cokernel with homology. Transport back along the exact equivalence, using mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso and quasi-coherence preservation by the inverse site equivalence (isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isLeftAdjoint). All transport steps are proved in the private Lean helpers qc_over_inverse, qc_homology, and qc_local_free_homology.

Exact restriction commutes with derived cohomology by mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. Apply homology to the representing isomorphism, then use homologyFunctorFactors to identify the result with P(y).homology n. Quasi-coherence is invariant under these isomorphisms. Apply SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop to the cover U(y), using Opens.coversTop_iff and membership of y in U(y), to obtain quasi-coherence of H^n(E).

proof_origin.place: Tag 08E5, local-model proof; written in Lean by X3 using the existing kernel and cokernel theorems
